seeds.note: exploration = the V1 training seeds (observation and Kane exploration only). development = 3200-3215 and holdout = 7100-7115 for the NEXT run: 3000-3003 were consumed by a smoke test, and 3100-3115 / 7000-7015 by the first full dry-run (2026-11-19T07-54-37Z-v2-dry, holdout unsealed once), so none of them is reused. The holdout is sealed until hypotheses and corrections are frozen and used once. V1 held-out seeds 5000-5011 are not reused. Each seed is played with both first-player orders; head-to-head seeds also swap the treated planner side.

kane.plan: 3 planned: 1 objective-mode exploration + 1 analyzer on the hypothesis comparison page + 1 analyzer on the post-correction page (only if a correction is executable). The 4th (objective challenge) is off by default.
kane.creditCapNote: 80 is an operating ceiling enforced BETWEEN calls: a successful kane-cli balance check is required before each call, a call is refused if the remaining budget is below its conservative estimate (objective 40, analyzer 15; V1 analyzer calls measured 5.4-6.5), and no call starts once measured spending reaches 80. A running kane-cli call cannot be stopped at a credit limit, so one call can overshoot; objective calls are additionally bounded by maxSteps and timeoutS.
